text_block_list.text:
One day, while walking through the academy,
I spotted Bamboo Memory standing motionless.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Since I was given time off,
I went to bed early to get some proper rest,
but I ended up waking up way earlier than expected...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I can't let a little sleepiness beat me.
Gotta psych myself up... Zzz...

It seems Bamboo Memory wasn't able
to rest properly.
